output_list.reason: The buyHeart function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function _hearts = (RoundETH[Round]).keysRec(msg.value); has an overflow condition where _hearts can be manipulated to a very large value, allowing users to buy an unexpected amount of tokens.

The buyHeart function has a wrong logic vulnerability. The function _pearn = (((msg.value.mul(30) / 100).mul(1000000000000000000)) / (RoundHeart[Round])).mul(_hearts)/ (1000000000000000000); has a wrong logic where it multiplies the _pearn by 1000000000000000000, causing a potential overflow issue.

The luckyBuy function has a bad randomness vulnerability. The function uint256 seed = uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked((block.timestamp).add(block.difficulty).add((uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(block.coinbase)))) / (now)).add(block.gaslimit).add((uint256(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(msg.sender)))) / (now)).add(block.number)))); has a bad randomness due to the predictable output, allowing attackers to manipulate the outcome.

The win function has a wrong logic vulnerability. The function require(now > RoundTime[Round] && RoundTime[Round] != 0); has a wrong logic where it only checks if the current time is greater than RoundTime[Round], not ensuring the RoundTime[Round] is not zero, causing a potential exploitable issue.

The withdraw function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function uint _revenue = getMyRevenue(_round); has an overflow condition where _revenue can be manipulated to a very large value, allowing users to withdraw an unexpected amount of tokens.
